verdict.rationale: Moneybird's own docs show invoice creation on desktop and mobile, plus online payment options for customers such as iDEAL, QR code, direct debit and credit card. The evidence does not explicitly document sending invoices, and says nothing about seeing when an invoice is viewed or paid. Missing for 10: explicit invoice-sending documentation, viewed/opened tracking, paid-status tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create and send invoices with online payment options and see when they are viewed and paid

citations.quote: You can create invoices from your desktop or directly in the Moneybird mobile app, and Moneybird takes care of the rest.
Make it easy for your customers to pay, for example via iDEAL, QR code, or direct debit.
Provide payment options such as iDEAL, credit card, or mobile payments.
